title: HTFProspectiveShadowLedgerEntry
description: Pre-registered schema for prospective shadow evaluation of HTF_RANGE_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT with MarketRegimeClassifier.

signal_id.description: Unique identifier for the breakout signal event.

timestamp_issue_utc.description: Timestamp when the 4h breakout bar closed and signal was issued.

breakout_bar_close.description: Close price of the breakout candle.

execution_open_price.description: Fill price at the open of the next candle (nxt['open']).

regime_at_entry.description: Macro regime classified by MarketRegimeClassifier at entry timestamp.

regime_confirmed_bars.description: Number of consecutive 1h bars confirming the regime.

filter_action.description: Whether the trade was executed in shadow portfolio or suppressed as chop.

cost_modeled_bps.description: Fixed Binance VIP0 modeled friction (20 comm + 2 spread + 2 base slip + 2 exp slip).

exit_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp when position closed (either stop hit or max 72h expired).

holding_hours.description: Duration the position was held (capped at 72.0h).

gross_return_bps.description: Gross percentage return in basis points.

net_return_bps.description: Net return after subtracting 26.0 bps cost.
